Name: Arba, Father of Anak
Summary: Arba, father of Anak, was the greatest man among the Anakim, and Kirjath-arba — that is, Hebron — was named for him.
KeyStory: Arba's name lived on in the city of the Anakim until Caleb drove them out and took Hebron for his inheritance.
LifeLesson: Even giants have fathers, and even their cities change hands.
